text:
Maya (Support): Customer seeing intermittent SSE cutoff when streaming via API. They provided two request ids: req_7f1a2b and req_9c3d4e. Can someone help with a minimal curl repro and collection steps?

Carlos (CS): I've asked the customer for the raw curl but they say the stream closes after ~30s. They attached partial logs (timestamped). They have a corporate proxy in front of the app.

Liam (Eng): Please get a curl that includes the full headers we expect. Typical good repro:
```
curl -v --no-buffer -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_7f1a2b" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream?model=gpt-infer"
```
Add `--compressed` if their client uses gzip. Also include `-x http://proxy:3128` if behind proxy.

Devon (SRE): When they run that, ask them to capture curl verbose output and save to a file: `curl -v --no-buffer ... > sse_dump.txt 2>&1`. We also need net traces: `tcpdump -w curl_sse.pcap host api.redwood-inference.com` if they can.

Maya (Support): I'll send the exact snippet to the customer. Also need them to run our debug bundle collector and paste the bundle link. Internal link: https://internal.redwood/debug-bundle (customer-facing collector: https://support.redwood.dev/debug).

infra-bot: Please attach the request ids to an internal ticket template: ticket/sse-cutoff-repro (automated).

Liam (Eng): If the curl reproduces the cutoff, ask them to toggle `Accept: text/event-stream` -> `Accept: application/json` to see if non-streaming works. If non-streaming succeeds, this points to connection/proxy timeouts.

Carlos (CS): Customer running the curl now, sent sse_dump.txt and attached req_7f1a2b. Uploading debug bundle to our collector, link: https://support.redwood.dev/bundles/84f2abc.

Maya (Support): Thanks — attaching those to the incident. Next steps: we will validate headers, check ingress timeouts, and test from our EU region to rule out regional infra.

Liam (Eng): I'll triage once I have the dump and pcap. If proxy is the cause, suggest using `Connection: keep-alive` + lower `heartbeat` from client side.

Maya (Support): Resolved plan: collect curl verbose, sse_dump.txt, pcap, debug bundle, and confirm proxy settings. I'll follow up with the customer with exact commands. :thumbsup:
